newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Offers in Vietnam 4Q oil products tender detailed.
newsitem.headline: Offers in Vietnam 4Q oil products tender detailed.

text.p: Offers in state-owned Vietnam National Petroleum Import-Export Corp's (Petrolimex) tender to buy gas oil for October-December delivery are between 90 cents and $1.10 a barrel over Singapore spot quotes, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The price is on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis and applies to both the 1.0-percent and 0.5-percent sulphur gas oil that Petrolimex seeks in the tender, they said.
Offers of gas oil and jet fuel on a free-on-board (fob) basis are around 20 cents a barrel over Singapore spot quotes, they said.
Petrolimex is seeking in this tender three 23,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil and six 22,500-to-23,000-tonne cargoes of 1.0-percet sulphur gas oil.
The tender also seeks five combination cargoes of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and jet-kerosene fuel.
In its third-quarter tender for July-September delivery, Petrolimex paid around $1.00 premiums for 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil on a c-and-f basis.
Industry sources also said Petrolimex has decided to defer the closing date of the tender to October 5 from October 3. The tender closed on September 27.

In the fourth quarter tender, low offers for fuel oil were seen at just more than $8.00 per tonne premium to Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f Ho Chi Minh City. High offers were seen around a $10-per-tonne premium, the sources said.
The tender seeks seven 27,000-tonne cargoes of 170-centistoke grade fuel oil, with a 3.0-percent sulphur content.
In its third quarter tender, Petrolimex bought six fuel oil cargoes around $8.10-per-tonne premiums, c-and-f.
Offers of 83-octane leaded gasoline in this tender are between $1.50 and $2.00 a barrel premium to Singapore naphtha quotes, c-and-f Hongai, Ho Chi Minh City or Danang.
The tender seeks three 18,000-tonne cargoes and three 17,000-tonne cargoes of gasoline.
In its last tender, it bought gasoline at around $1.80-per-barrel premium, c-and-f.
